name: Cask of Shimmer Stout
summary: In Dun Morogh's cold heights, Cask of Shimmer Stout is bound for the eastern mountains. Rejold Barleybrew brewed the potent new ale, and his brother sends a cask east as a gift for fellow dwarven mountaineers.

sections.title: A Spirited Delivery
sections.body: Rejold Barleybrew brews Shimmer Stout in Brewnall Village, where local patrons and mountaineers who brave Dun Morogh's biting frosts take to it quickly. Impressed by his brother's brew, Mountaineer Barleybrew commissions a cask to be hauled through the eastern pass into Loch Modan. Dwarves prize strong drink for company and for warmth in the mountain chill. Sharing a fresh brew with comrades on distant patrols is a military tradition.

sections.title: A Dwarven Pick-Me-Up
sections.body: During his watch in Thelsamar, Mountaineer Kadrell opens the cask and samples the brew. Shimmer Stout lives up to its reputation: one draught is said to lighten the limbs and make a soldier feel as though he could fly. It is the sort of invigorating drink a dwarven scout might welcome on a long, lonely patrol along the high roads.

faq.answer: Shimmer Stout is a potent dwarven ale brewed by Rejold Barleybrew in Dun Morogh's cold heights. Its strong kick is renowned for invigorating the body and keeping the cold at bay.

faq.q: Who is the cask being sent to?
faq.answer: The cask is being sent to Mountaineer Kadrell, a guard stationed along the road through Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why send ale across the mountains?
faq.answer: Dwarven mountaineers often share fine brews with comrades on distant patrols. After tasting Rejold Barleybrew's new creation, his brother wants Kadrell to sample it.

faq.q: What effect does Shimmer Stout have on the drinker?
faq.answer: Shimmer Stout is surprisingly potent. After tasting it, Mountaineer Kadrell says it makes his head spin, lightens his limbs, and leaves him feeling as if he could fly.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know fine ale shared between patrols is a respected tradition that binds the far-flung Mountaineers across the rugged peaks of Khaz Modan.
